signature: SUBROUTINE DGGSVD3( JOBU, JOBV, JOBQ, M, N, P, K, L, A, LDA, B,

params.name: jobu
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Orthogonal matrix U is computed;
-   `= 'N'`: U is not computed.

params.name: jobv
params.reference:
-   `= 'V'`: Orthogonal matrix V is computed;
-   `= 'N'`: V is not computed.

params.name: jobq
params.reference:
-   `= 'Q'`: Orthogonal matrix Q is computed;
-   `= 'N'`: Q is not computed.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: P
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix B. $P \ge 0$.

params.name: l
params.reference: On exit, K and L specify the dimension of the subblocks described in Purpose. K + L = effective numerical rank of $(A^T,B^T)^T$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix A. On exit, A contains the triangular matrix R, or part of R. See Purpose for details.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the P-by-N matrix B. On exit, B contains the triangular matrix R if $M-K-L < 0$. See Purpose for details.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,P)$.

params.name: BETA
params.reference:
On exit, `ALPHA` and `BETA` contain the generalized singular value pairs of A and B;

$$
\mathrm{ALPHA}(1:K) = 1
$$

$$
\mathrm{BETA}(1:K) = 0
$$

and if $M-K-L \ge 0$,

$$
\mathrm{ALPHA}(K+1:K+L) = C
$$

$$
\mathrm{BETA}(K+1:K+L) = S
$$

or if $M-K-L < 0$,

$$
\mathrm{ALPHA}(K+1:M)=C, \mathrm{ALPHA}(M+1:K+L)=0
$$

$$
\mathrm{BETA}(K+1:M) =S, \mathrm{BETA}(M+1:K+L) =1
$$

and

$$
\mathrm{ALPHA}(K+L+1:N) = 0
$$

$$
\mathrm{BETA}(K+L+1:N) = 0
$$

params.name: U
params.reference: If `JOBU = 'U'`, U contains the M-by-M orthogonal matrix U. If `JOBU = 'N'`, U is not referenced.

params.name: ldu
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array U. $\mathrm{LDU} \ge \max (1,M)$ if `JOBU = 'U'`; $\mathrm{LDU} \ge 1$ otherwise.

params.name: V
params.reference: If `JOBV = 'V'`, V contains the P-by-P orthogonal matrix V. If `JOBV = 'N'`, V is not referenced.

params.name: ldv
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array V. $\mathrm{LDV} \ge \max (1,P)$ if `JOBV = 'V'`; $\mathrm{LDV} \ge 1$ otherwise.

params.name: Q
params.reference: If `JOBQ = 'Q'`, Q contains the N-by-N orthogonal matrix Q. If `JOBQ = 'N'`, Q is not referenced.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge \max (1,N)$ if `JOBQ = 'Q'`; $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$ otherwise.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: IWORK
params.reference:
On exit, `IWORK` stores the sorting information. More precisely, the following loop will sort `ALPHA`

-   for $I = K+1$, min(M,K+L) swap `ALPHA(I)` and `ALPHA(IWORK(I))`
-   endfor

such that $\mathrm{ALPHA}(1) \ge \mathrm{ALPHA}(2)$ \>= ... \>= `ALPHA(N)`.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = 1`, the Jacobi-type procedure failed to converge.  For further details, see subroutine DTGSJA.

notes: check INFO=-24 tests LWORK, not argument 24 (INFO): the reference misnumbers it
